subject: VerdantHealth — security questionnaire kickoff & routing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: VerdantHealth — security questionnaire kickoff & routing

Hi Elena — great to meet yesterday. Quick recap and next steps to keep momentum on the security intake: 

Call recap (2 key items)
- VerdantHealth is evaluating Redwood for inference in a B2B clinical workflow (no PHI in initial POC; potential PHI in later phase).
- Main compliance asks: SOC 2 status, GDPR residency options, and HIPAA readiness for later phases.

Immediate asks / clarifying questions
1) Preferred questionnaire: do you want us to send SIG (preferred for our procurement), CAIQ, or a custom vendor form your legal team uses? We can prefill SIG to save time.
2) Data residency: confirm whether EU residency is required for the POC or only for full production.
3) PHI scope: you mentioned "no PHI in the POC" — can you confirm expected token sources (uploads, API only)?
4) Timeline: what target date does your procurement/security team want completed for vendor security checks?

Attachments Im sending (see Drive link for working copies):
- SIG_PREFILL_Template.xlsx (prefill we can return if you choose SIG)
- Redwood onboarding checklist (short) — attached to the Drive folder link above

Suggested routing
- If SIG/CAIQ: we’ll return a prefill within 48 hours.
- For evidence requests (SOC 2, network diagrams, dataflow): Ill loop Kim (security SME) for technical evidence mapping and Marissa for logistics/attachments.

Next steps
- Elena: confirm preferred questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ/custom) + target completion date.
- Aditya/Marissa: once confirmed, we’ll send prefill and schedule a 30-min evidence-review call with Kim.

Thanks — Ill hold on sending the full prefill until you confirm questionnaire type so we dont duplicate work.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0102

[Attachment: SIG_PREFILL_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@verdanthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VerdantHealth — security questionnaire kickoff & routing

Thanks, Aditya — appreciate the clear summary. Confirming a few items from our side: 

1) Questionnaire: legal prefers CAIQ for first pass because it aligns with our vendor intake dashboard. If CAIQ is not available, SIG prefill is acceptable — whichever is faster.
2) SOC 2: we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report; attaching a redacted copy for your review. Report window: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
3) PHI: For the POC we will not send PHI. Production could involve PHI depending on the integration; well flag that in later stages.
4) Timeline: procurement needs vendor sign-off by 2027-01-20 to hit our Q1 onboarding.

Clarifying questions for Redwood: 
- For CAIQ: do you accept a prefilled spreadsheet (we usually do) or do you require a JSON export?
- Evidence: what specific artifacts do you typically request after the questionnaire (network diagrams, encryption configs, access reviews, etc.)? A brief checklist would be helpful so we can assemble things.

Attaching: Verdant_SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf

Happy to join the evidence-review call; Samir and I are available Thu 12/17 10–12 PT or Fri 12/18 9–11 PT.

—Elena
Elena Martinez
Head of Procurement | VerdantHealth
elena.martinez@verdanthealth.com
[Attachment: Verdant_SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks for the SOC 2 doc and the timeline, Elena — that helps. Quick responses and plan: 

- CAIQ vs SIG: we can accept a CAIQ spreadsheet prefill or return a SIG prefill. Given your timeline (target 2027-01-20), CAIQ prefill from you + a short Redwood review will be the fastest route. If youd rather we prefill SIG so procurement has a uniform artifact, we can do that in 48 hours after your confirmation.

- Evidence checklist (short):
  * Network diagram (internal/external boundary)
  * Dataflow diagram (where tokens originate, any third-party processors)
  * SOC 2 report (you attached, thanks)
  * Encryption at rest/in transit description (KMS details optional)
  * Access control summary (IAM + 3rd party access)
  * Any HIPAA BAAs or related controls if you anticipate PHI in production

Ill attach a working evidence map (redwood-security-evidence-map.xlsx) to the Drive folder and Marissa will coordinate a secure upload location.

Proposed next step: schedule a 30-min evidence triage call with Kim to walk through the checklist and map owners. You suggested Thu 12/17 10–12 PT — we can do 10:30–11:00 PT. If that works Ill calendar invite.

Marissa: can you set up the secure upload (S3 presigned link or shared Drive folder with restricted access) and capture the expected file formats?

Elena: if CAIQ prefill is easiest for you, feel free to send the spreadsheet and well mark anything outstanding.

Best,
Aditya

Hi Elena — Kim from Redwood security here. Thanks for sending the SOC 2. A quick outline of what Id like to cover on the triage call: 

Agenda (30 min)
- Walk through the CAIQ (or SIG) prefill and confirm any high-risk flags (5–7 min)
- Evidence mapping: identify owners for network diagram, dataflow, and encryption details (10 min)
- Clarify residency/processing boundaries for later production (5 min)
- Next actions & timeline to close procurement gate (5 min)

Evidence notes (to prepare if youre able)
- Network diagram (PNG/PDF) showing subnet boundaries and where Redwood endpoints will be accessed from.
- Dataflow document (simple Confluence page or PDF) describing ingestion points and retention expectations.
- Copy of any BAA language (if you anticipate PHI later).

Scheduling: Thu 2026-12-17 10:30–11:00 PT works for me. Ill send a calendar invite to lock it in. If youd prefer Fri 12/18, we can shift.

Security note: once we receive artifacts please upload to the secure folder (link in calendar invite). Marissa will send the upload instructions and a presigned link.

Look forward to working through this with you.

Kimberly Park
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
